text:
Anna CSM: FYI — Sunline told Jared yesterday their legal team put the signature on hold. Usage telemetry shows a ~70% drop this week, mostly API calls. We need a short playbook to keep them from churning.
Jared AE: Confirmed. Procurement called me this morning. Legal's main questions are around data retention, subprocessor list, and whether rolling logs can be exported for audits.
Maya (Sunline PM): Sorry for the radio silence — we're waiting on our GC. They're asking for an export of 30 days of request logs + our SOC2 cert. Also flagged concerns about third-party analytics.
Tom Support: Ticket #4521 created for the API block — looks like their infra team added an IP deny rule after a security scan. Error logs: 403 from our gateway, see snippet: ```{"status":403,"reason":"IP_DENY","ip":"34.120.11.8"}```
Priya SE: We can offer a scoped fix: temporary allowlist for Sunline management IPs + generate a sanitized logs export (remove PII) to satisfy legal. Also can propose a VPC endpoint plan if they need no public egress.
Anna CSM: Actionable plan proposal: 1) Bridge call with Sunline legal + infra + our security (today/Thu) 2) Provide 30-day logs export (sanitized) + SOC2 and subprocessors list 3) Offer a 30-day trial extension or seat credit while legal reviews 4) Temporary allowlist to resume traffic. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Jared AE: Good. I'm ok with the extension/credit. I'll push to procurement. I scheduled a 30-min bridge Thu 11:00am PT and invited our security & engineering.
Maya (Sunline PM): Thu 11 works. Legal asked for an NDA amendment example — can ContractBot draft a short addendum we can share?
contract-bot: Generated draft addendum (v1) and uploaded to the thread: https://files.redwood.dev/addendum/sunline-v1.pdf
Tom Support: I've attached the raw gateway logs and an export checklist to ticket #4521. Link: https://support.redwood.dev/tickets/4521
Priya SE: Quick config we can propose on the call (paste for legal to see): ```# temporary allowlist
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood.dev/allowlist -d '{"ip":"34.120.11.8","expires":"2026-04-05T17:00:00Z"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer xxxxx'```
Anna CSM: I'll draft the one-pager for legal Qs (retention, subprocessors, encryption, logs redaction) and post it before the call. Priya, can you prepare the sanitized logs sample?
Priya SE: On it — will redact PII and include a schema for fields removed. ETA: 2 hours.
Jared AE: I'll confirm procurement is okay with a short addendum + seat credit. If they sign the addendum we can unblock the contract queue immediately.
Maya (Sunline PM): Appreciate the quick turnaround. If we can get the sample logs and addendum before Thu I'll push legal to review earlier.
Anna CSM: Thanks team. Next steps: Anna to post one-pager + meeting agenda; Priya to upload sanitized logs; Jared to follow procurement; Tom to keep ticket updated. I'll ping again once materials are uploaded. :white_check_mark:
